tier3_constraints.constraint_text: All patient data must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Access must follow role-based access control with audit logging of all PHI access per HIPAA requirements.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint focuses on data confidentiality, integrity, and non-repudiation, which are core concerns for the SecurityAgent.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system must maintain 99.95% uptime with automatic failover. Planned maintenance windows shall not exceed 4 hours per month.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint emphasizes the system's availability and fault tolerance, which are key concerns for the ReliabilityAgent.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: Clinical note retrieval must complete within 2 seconds. The system must support 5000 concurrent users across all facilities during peak hours.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint focuses on the performance and resource utilization of the system, which are core concerns for the PerformanceAgent.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The interface must be accessible to clinical staff with varying technical proficiency. Mobile access must be available for rounding physicians.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint emphasizes the usability and accessibility of the system, which are key concerns for the UsabilityAgent.

tier3_constraints.constraint_text: The system shall support HL7 FHIR R4 APIs for data exchange with external laboratories, pharmacies, and insurance providers. Legacy HL7 v2 interfaces must be maintained for existing integrations.
tier3_constraints.reasoning: This constraint focuses on the interoperability of the system with external systems, which are core concerns for the CompatibilityAgent.
